question: Which museum comes up first when traveling toward the George Washington University - Arlington Education Center, Arlington, VA from Mays Chapel Medical Care Center, Lutherville, MD?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.663402 39.458755)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-77.115914 38.881333)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'museum'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.663402 39.458755)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-76.663402 39.458755)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

answers.poi_name: Howard County Center of African American Culture

[2].display_name: Mays Chapel Medical Care Center, Lutherville, MD

[3].display_name: The George Washington University - Arlington Education Center, Arlington, VA

poi.poi_name: The George Washington University - Arlington Education Center
